verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents migrating data into Stripe (the Billing migration toolkit and imports from Zuora, Recurly, Chargebee). Nothing in the pack documents exporting subscriptions, invoices, or usage records, or porting stored payment methods out to another provider. The general Subscriptions API is a developer building block, and a community team hand-writing code to leave Stripe is a user-side workaround; neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave
